subject.title: Make Google Chat DM thread sessions configurable

question: Should this PR's `channels.googlechat.threadSessions` config name/scope and `parentPeer` inbound-envelope SDK helper expansion be the maintained Google Chat DM thread-session API?
rationale: The implementation is plausible, but the PR creates public config and SDK surface while several overlapping Google Chat thread/session PRs remain open with competing option names and scopes.

options.title: Accept Narrow ThreadSessions Shape
options.body: Approve this default-off DM-thread mode after rebase, generated baselines, and current-head live Google Chat proof.

options.title: Keep Routing Private
options.body: Ask for the parent-peer plumbing to stay inside Google Chat or an already-approved SDK route seam before merging.

options.title: Consolidate Thread PRs
options.body: Pause this PR and choose one canonical Google Chat thread/session plan across the overlapping open PRs.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow ThreadSessions Shape
recommendation.body: Approve this default-off DM-thread mode after rebase, generated baselines, and current-head live Google Chat proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across Google Chat monitor behavior, routing/session changes, and Plugin SDK/public-surface review.
